_doc: Step 78 pacing baseline -- NOT a target. The owner asked for every building's production x5 slower again (balance.pace.production: the work of every stage x5 more, so x31.25 of the data seconds; the wait after a stage -- a watered crop ripening -- x5, unscaled until now; construction x5 more, so x12.5) and explicitly for the slower incremental feel rather than the old income back, so no price or EXP was raised. This file is what the deterministic simulator measured on the Step 78 game, 'blind' profile (tools/balance_optimizer/optimize.gd --profile blind --minutes 480), on 2026-11-01: seconds of active play to each journey mark, money by 10 and 60 minutes, and the first moment the island can be sold. Against Step 69's (baseline_step69.json, kept as history): first income 14 -> 39 s, a Momo's first income 76 -> 168 s, Lv 2 188 -> 663 s, the first research 368 -> 1200 s, money by an hour $11,923 -> $1,013, the island sellable 64 -> 209 minutes -- about x3.5, not x5, because walking, the 30 s day, research topics and letters keep their times. tests/unit/sim/test_balance.gd keeps the game within `tolerance` of it (a regression guard, both ways) and checks no dead end. Re-measure and rewrite this file only with a deliberate pace change, and say so in design/INCREMENTAL_BALANCE_REPORT.md.
